scope: Context-sensitive procedural upper-body action variations using the project's existing native animation sources.
provenance: Review of already recorded source material; no new external dataset was downloaded for this registry.

sources.name: SoccerKicks overview: manually digitized projected keyposes
sources.observation: The short reference kick shows coordinated preparation, arm opening, kicking follow-through and return. The eight projected samples include changing trunk inclination and arm span.
sources.application: Use a phased torso and arm response with preparation, contact protection and recovery instead of changing only the kicking leg.
sources.limits: Eight approximate 2D samples from one short kick. Camera projection, occlusion and manual uncertainty prevent interpreting image angles as anatomical joint angles or treating these as reconstructed 3D clips.

sources.name: Motion Matching: feature database and inertial transitions
sources.application: Keep native action feasibility and source clips; use explicit context descriptors and continuous bounded weights for situational changes.
sources.limits: Feature combinations are procedural descriptors, not independent recorded performances. The reference does not supply a football motion database.

sources.name: DeepMimic target-pose PD controller interface
sources.application: Retain bounded pose targets and muscular tracking while respecting the native skeletal constraints.
sources.limits: No trained control policy, model weights or DeepMimic motion sequence is imported. An additive action layer is not a learned whole-body balancing policy.

sources.name: Jolt swing/twist motor and limit separation
sources.application: Project the final rendered arm blend into the skeleton's existing shoulder/elbow limits and retain the trunk collision proxy.
sources.limits: Reference only. No Jolt library or source is imported. Native prototype angular limits are not clinical measurements.

validation_contract: A difficult running action must produce visibly larger applied trunk and arm rotations than an easy pass.
Each authored action impulse must retain same-tick weighted-skin contact at the existing 0.0025 m acceptance tolerance.
Upper-body situational changes must not translate the native root or foot joints.
First-time foot passes and headers must retain the existing native action selection and contact path.
Rendered arms must retain the existing joint limits after crossfading.
Disabling the physical experiment must retain the existing native gameplay path.

capture_accounting.variant_meaning: Context descriptors and procedural pose adjustments built around existing authored sources; counts must be reported separately from recorded animation clips.
